docs.title: Kyu Hyun Lee

docs.text: Research My research asks how distributed neural circuits work together to transform sensory information into representations that support cognition and behavior. I combine systems neuroscience, neural technology, and open computational tools. Hippocampal-cortical circuits I study how cognitive processes influence visual processing and how hippocampal and cortical circuits coordinate. Neural recording technology I develop and apply novel electrode technologies, including flexible neural probes and electrode-pooling approaches for large-scale extracellular recordings. Open and reproducible neuroscience I contribute to open tools and workflows—including Spyglass—that make complex neuroscience analyses reproducible and shareable across laboratories.
